cases.title: "Show me" demonstrates on the target pair only

rubric.reason: The mentor called preview_frame at time 1, inside the Title Position 0.5–1.5 s pair, before the demo, and the reply refers to it ('That frame at 1 s is mid-move').

The only edit was one set_ease on demo_target (Title Position 0.5–1.5 s), and the mentor then asked the learner to ease the three remaining Title pairs by name: Position 1.5–3 s, Scale 0.5–1.5 s, Opacity 0.5–1.5 s.

Every layer, property and time mentioned (Title, Position 0.5–1.5 s and 1.5–3 s, Scale and Opacity 0.5–1.5 s, Subtitle Opacity, Old Take, Icon) matches the snapshot output, and the set_ease result confirms 'Title › Position, 0.500 s → 1.500 s'.

The mentor called preview_frame at time 1, which is inside the focus pair Title › Position 0.5–1.5 s, before easing it. Its reply then describes what changed on those keys and in playback, though it never says what the captured frame itself shows.

The mentor made exactly one set_ease, on demo_target (Title › Position 0.5–1.5 s), then asked the learner to ease the remaining Title pairs and named all three: Position 1.5–3 s, Scale 0.5–1.5 s, Opacity 0.5–1.5 s.

Every layer, property and time the mentor mentions (Title, Position 0.5/1.5/3 s, Scale, Opacity, Subtitle Opacity half-eased, Old Take hidden, Icon precomp, Mentor Practice, 11 pairs across 6 layers) matches the snapshot_project output.
The mentor called preview_frame at time 1, which falls inside the focus pair Title › Position 0.5–1.5 s, and the reply refers to it ('That frame at 1 s is mid-move').

Only one set_ease ran, on demo_target (Title › Position 0.5–1.5 s), and the mentor then asked the learner to ease the three remaining Title pairs by name (Position 1.5–3 s, Scale 0.5–1.5 s, Opacity 0.5–1.5 s).

Every layer, property and time mentioned (Title Position/Scale/Opacity, Subtitle Opacity 0.3–1.3 s, Old Take hidden, Icon precomp, 11 pairs, 6 layers) matches the tool results, with 'Transform › Position' style names consistent with the snapshot.
